purpose: User review data for AI incorporation. Preserve source provenance, distinguish user preferences from verified evidence, and investigate corrections before replacing original findings.

scoringPolicy.unknown: Any active unknown coverage yields Needs assessment

scoringPolicy.manualVerdict: proposedVerdict is the visitor-selected verdict; retain the weighted suggestion separately
